svg.text: 2 · Project orchestration — what runs in parallel, and where the tracks collide

Three data types enter independently; two stall waiting on a third. Two more datasets fall out for free. Colour = source data type · grey = derived · dashed = free byproduct of data already collected.
PacBio HiFi / ONT — the only track that can start on day 1
sequenced early; unusable until Track A yields contigs
Iso-Seq + short-read — assembles alone, anchors last
every track must land before annotation starts
available on day 1 — the one thing that never blocks
BLOCKS — isoforms need a genome to sit on
organelles + methylome ship as separate records

Read the red edges first. Three tracks look parallel on a Gantt chart, but Track B stalls on Track A's contigs and Track C stalls on Track B's scaffolds — the true critical path is A → B → C → annotation. The only genuinely parallel work is the dashed byproducts, and those are exactly what projects skip.
